department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: April 15 online submission deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: The online submission deadline is when the initial application must be submitted online, provided the department has no earlier deadline. By the file completion deadline, admission must be granted and all documents required to obtain a student visa must be submitted to the Division of Global Engagement.

gre_general.value: Graduate Record Examination scores are required for admission.
gre_general.quote: Students may apply directly to the PhD program either with or without having completed a master’s degree. Students proceeding directly to the PhD program from a baccalaureate degree should submit evidence of outstanding performance in a rigorous undergraduate program and the ability to perform independent research at the doctoral level. Graduate Record Examination scores and at least three letters of reference are required for admission.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Chemical Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Funding package details not stated on catalog page.
